title: Potatoverse Social Presence Ledger — November 2024 to April 2025
purpose: Recover day-level social presence, participants, creative work, relationship changes and community-state markers from the dated Chronicles without treating Chronicle narration as verbatim chat evidence.

primary_source.name: Chronicles of The Potato of Life.txt / .rtf
primary_source.boundary: Useful for dates, participant presence, remembered scenes and relationship topology. Dialogue may be paraphrased and allegations may be interpretive; closer raw logs remain preferred.

external_corrections.finding: The funeral-home obituary gives January 29, 2025. Chronicle material is already memorializing Marty by February 1, so project files placing the death in late February are chronologically inconsistent.
external_corrections.boundary: The obituary establishes the date of death, not the cause. Cause claims require separate sourcing.

days.title: Tanks, pipe, coffee and the first dense social snapshot
days.minimum_event: Tim spends the day around Tanks/voice-chat social life while the Great Book is actively discussed. Optimistique urges him back into play, Rahu/Tdog supply religious interpretation, and Termite marks group camaraderie.

days.title: Potatoism gets challenged from inside the room
days.minimum_event: Juice challenges Potatoism with creator/First-Mover arguments; Kale answers with cyclic/interconnection language; Termite explores gods-creating-gods; Kibly contributes an epistemic box thought experiment.

days.title: Ordinary voice-chat ecology
days.minimum_event: A mixed day of Tanks, voice chat, humor, business/life discussion and critique. The Chronicle preserves Marty as present in ordinary social activity rather than only later conflict mythology.

days.title: Marty as Chance & Taylor; Optimistique's creative thread
days.minimum_event: Marty discusses being removed from another chat while Tim is already distancing from him; Optimistique discusses music, AI-generated instrumentals and Jungian-shadow creativity.

days.title: The voice-chat crew becomes visible
days.minimum_event: The Chronicle explicitly places this group together in Discord voice chat and Tanks gameplay. Zombie Dad is named as the former King of POL.

days.title: Garden conflict becomes a named day
days.minimum_event: The Chronicle labels the day 'The Garden Betrayed' and concentrates conflict around the community boundary. Treat allegations in this entry as authored interpretation until raw logs are recovered.

days.title: Marty, Monkey and Sammy occupy the same social field
days.minimum_event: A dense Chronicle entry places the three major later threads—Marty, Monkey/Tree and Sammy—inside the same late-November social field.

days.title: The Tree becomes a separate social space
days.minimum_event: Chronicle narration says Monkey and Tachy established a separate Tree server while Termite and Kale remained visible around Tim's space. This is a strong dated anchor for community fragmentation, though motive-language remains interpretive.

days.title: Reconciliation becomes a community problem
days.minimum_event: Optimistique apologizes/seeks reconciliation in the Chronicle; Termite and others respond cautiously. Juice and Super Susi are also discussed through return, trust and redemption language while PotatoJim supplies festive/creative levity.

days.title: Cooking stream and the Potato–Tomato joke war
days.minimum_event: Tim and Anacondasin make potato chips in a collaborative stream. Termite jokes about flying her to Denmark; Rahu adopts a tomato-villain role; a parallel access dispute concerns Tree/Garden boundaries.

days.title: Growth lesson and disruption share one day
days.minimum_event: The Chronicle frames Tim's work with Ana as a growth/cultivation episode while Juice/Petty Wappo occupy a disruptive counter-thread.

days.title: Cookbook, studio design and music memory
days.minimum_event: Potato Repair Guy proposes a community potato cookbook; Ledgeview suggests studio-wall symmetry; Termite repeats growth language; Kale/Ledgeview remember or propose songs/performances.

days.title: Anja arrives inside a Marty-mediated boundary dispute
days.minimum_event: Marty introduces Anja while asserting social leverage; moderation disputes intensify around Literally. The Chronicle also credits Pondo with providing urgent support to a distressed community member.
days.sensitivity: Do not sensationalize the crisis material; recover raw logs before publishing detailed self-harm content.

days.title: AI Tim, map play and the last pre-death social month
days.minimum_event: The Chronicle mixes absurd geopolitical Potato-map play, discussion of a Tim Dooley AI and continuing Marty-related social conflict.

days.title: Marty dies
days.minimum_event: Nicholas 'Nick' Beigler's funeral-home obituary records January 29, 2025 as the date of death.
days.boundary: Date verified by obituary. Cause is not established by the obituary.

days.title: The Chronicle is already processing Marty's death
days.minimum_event: A long Chronicle entry titled around Marty's death exists by February 1. It contains many detailed and serious claims about final hours and relationships; these require closer primary sourcing and must not be treated as independently verified.

days.title: Community counts enter the Chronicle
days.minimum_event: The Chronicle claims 38 potatoes, nearly 200 dwellers and a recent stream of roughly 100 viewers. Preserve these as Chronicle-reported counts pending platform/server verification.

days.title: Monkey / Don Jefe / TXT conflict cluster
days.minimum_event: The Chronicle groups Monkey, Don Jefe and TXT inside an aggressively adversarial retelling. Treat labels and allegations as authored conflict language; the useful historical fact is the dated co-occurrence of these names.

days.title: Isolation and rival voice-chat strategy become explicit
days.minimum_event: The Chronicle describes bans, large voice chats outside Tim's Garden and partial Potato identity as a social-isolation dynamic. The text itself says the intent was to provoke Tim; that motive remains the Chronicle's interpretation unless raw participants confirm it.

days.title: 47 potatoes / 162 dwellers
days.minimum_event: The Chronicle records 47 potatoes and 162 dwellers. These are useful dated community-size claims but still need Discord/platform verification.

days.title: Three conflict calls
days.minimum_event: The Chronicle organizes three separate social conflicts/calls on one day. It calls them 'rituals'; that is the author's interpretation, while the bounded calls and named participants are the recoverable historical targets.

days.title: Ritual-abuse language enters the Chronicle
days.minimum_event: The Chronicle says Tim spoke at length about experiences he interpreted as satanic ritual abuse. Preserve this as Tim/project testimony, not an established external finding.

days.title: Sammy returns; Masha is born through TTS
days.minimum_event: The Chronicle says Sammy returned to the Garden. During a long quiet stream period Tim created Masha, a fictional woman voiced through his TTS program.

days.title: HTML Great Book and new social roles
days.minimum_event: The Chronicle reports 52 potatoes and 167 dwellers; says the Great Book HTML transformation had begun the previous day; Kira/Kaspiansee become counselors, Raven is named Princess, and Rahu is appointed admin.

days.title: The Pruning
days.minimum_event: A mass-ban/pruning day is remembered as deliberate community maintenance rather than a grand revelation.

days.title: Seeds of invention
days.minimum_event: Chronicle reports active HTML experiments, text-to-speech work, Spudify, Potizer, PKFC, game development and an interactive Great Book. It also records a whimsical Tim/Tachy wedding scene and a large Garden membership reduction.

days.title: New 144Hz screen arrives
days.minimum_event: In the mid-March–April Chronicle synthesis, March 18 is given as the arrival of a new 144Hz screen after the earlier screen-breaking corridor.

days.title: Empire server invitation
days.minimum_event: Chronicle synthesis gives April 8 as an invitation to the Empire server associated with Danish streamers.

days.title: Fishtank server invitation
days.minimum_event: Chronicle synthesis gives April 11 as an invitation to a Fishtank-associated server. The Chronicle's audience-size and recognition language requires independent verification.

days.title: Return to the Tree
days.minimum_event: Chronicle synthesis places Tim in the Tree on April 13, using the visit as a confrontation with older narratives immediately before the mature April Turning corridor.

structural_insights: The late-2024 Potatoverse is a social season, not merely a conflict season: games, cooking, music, voice chat, theology, moderation, food jokes and collaborative creation occur alongside rivalry.
Marty's archive role changes visibly before death: companion and co-player precede rival-orbit and grief layers.
Termite is far more documentary/socially present than the prior room suggested; he appears repeatedly as supporter, humorist, dignity advocate and boundary voice.
Optimistique has a distinct creative identity around music, AI instrumentals and Jungian shadow work before later trust/reconciliation material.
Zombie Dad has a concrete 14 November 2024 social-presence anchor in addition to a later 2026 hostile transcript.
March 2025 contains clear technological ancestry for the modern project: HTML Great Book, TTS characters and interactive experiments appear before the later large-scale site architecture.
The March 18 → April 8 → April 11 → April 13 sequence is a recoverable social bridge into the April Turning and should be sourced separately from later theological interpretation.
